Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo earlier this week. Wed like to get a formal console walkthrough + API enablement session scheduled for our engineering and product teams so we can start the pilot.

High level:
- Audience: 5 engineers (NY / remote) + 2 product managers
- Goals: console walkthrough, API keys & sample calls, quick integration checklist
- Preferred window: next week (Nov 30-Dec 3) mornings ET or late afternoons ET

Couple of constraints: our lead infra engineer (Alan) is on Pacific time and prefers a start no earlier than 11:00 PT. Can you propose a few slots that work for your team and indicate if you can accommodate the staggered regional attendees?

Also please share any short prep doc we can circulate.

- Wed, Dec 2, 16:30 ET / 13:30 PT (60 min) — extended Q&A and integration patterns
